from pathlib import Path
import argparse,subprocess,json,hashlib,statistics,time,fcntl,resource,random
p=Path(__file__).parent;r=Path('/home/reinsirk/Atcoder_Env');old=Path('/tmp/sirkit_rh_20261022');parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--variants',nargs='+',default=['baseline','control','bytes']);parser.add_argument('--rounds',type=int,default=7);parser.add_argument('--name',default='bytes-main');parser.add_argument('--compiler',choices=['gcc','clang'],default='gcc');parser.add_argument('--fallback',action='store_true');parser.add_argument('--all',action='store_true');parser.add_argument('--disable-simd',action='store_true');args=parser.parse_args();sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
driver=(r/'Verify/current/drivers/rolling_hash_zalgorithm_main.cpp').read_text();io=(r/'Verify/current/common/fast_io.hpp').read_text();main=driver.replace('#include "Verify/current/common/fast_io.hpp"',io)
cc=['/usr/bin/g++']if args.compiler=='gcc'else['/usr/bin/clang++','--gcc-install-dir=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/15'];flags=['-std=c++23','-O2',*(['-U__SIZEOF_INT128__','-DSIRKIT_FORCE_STANDARD_ARITHMETIC','-DSIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD']if args.fallback else ['-march=native','-DEVAL','-DONLINE_JUDGE']if args.compiler=='gcc'else[])];refs={}
if args.disable_simd:flags+=['-DSIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD']
for inp in sorted((old/'official').glob('*.in')):
 if not args.all and inp.name not in ['all_same_00.in','binary_carry_00.in','random_00.in','random_01.in','random_02.in','periodic_00.in','periodic_01.in']:continue
 out=old/'reference_outputs'/(inp.name+'.out');assert out.exists();refs[inp.name]={'input':str(inp),'input_sha256':sha(inp.read_bytes()),'output_sha256':sha(out.read_bytes())}
assert refs
builds=[]
for v in args.variants:
 if v=='control':continue
 body=p/(v+'.hpp');tu=p/(args.name+'-'+v+'.cpp');tu.write_text('#define SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS\n'+body.read_text()+main);cmd=['taskset','-c','6',*cc,*flags,str(tu),'-o',str(p/(args.name+'-'+v))];q=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True);assert q.returncode==0,q.stderr;builds.append(dict(variant=v,cmd=cmd,source_sha256=sha(body.read_bytes()),diagnostics=q.stderr))
data={v:{c:[]for c in refs}for v in args.variants};rng=random.Random(190207)
with open('/tmp/sirkit_performance_cpu14.lock','a')as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
 for rep in range(args.rounds):
  for c,ref in refs.items():
   vs=list(args.variants);rng.shuffle(vs)
   for v in vs:
    exe=p/(args.name+'-'+('baseline'if v=='control'else v));out=p/(args.name+'.out')
    with Path(ref['input']).open('rb')as inp,out.open('wb')as f:
     before=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN);start=time.perf_counter_ns();q=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','14',str(exe)],stdin=inp,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.PIPE);wall=(time.perf_counter_ns()-start)/1e6;after=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    assert q.returncode==0 and not q.stderr and sha(out.read_bytes())==ref['output_sha256'],(v,c,q.stderr)
    cpu=(after.ru_utime+after.ru_stime-before.ru_utime-before.ru_stime)*1000;data[v][c].append(dict(wall_ms=wall,cpu_ms=cpu))
  print('round',rep,flush=True)
med={v:{c:statistics.median(x['cpu_ms']for x in xs)for c,xs in cs.items()}for v,cs in data.items()};res={'raw':data,'median_ms':med,'ratio':{v:{c:med[v][c]/med['baseline'][c]for c in refs}for v in args.variants},'builds':builds,'driver_sha256':sha(driver.encode()),'io_sha256':sha(io.encode()),'fixtures':refs};(p/(args.name+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(res,indent=2));print(json.dumps({'median_ms':med,'ratio':res['ratio']},indent=2),flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,statistics,random,fcntl
p=Path(__file__).parent;raw={v:{pat:[]for pat in [8,9]}for v in ['baseline','control','final']};rng=random.Random(821004)
with open('/tmp/sirkit_performance_cpu14.lock','a')as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
 for rep in range(31):
  for pat in [8,9]:
   vs=list(raw);rng.shuffle(vs);checks=[]
   for v in vs:
    exe=p/f'compare_clang_standard_{"baseline"if v=="control"else v}';q=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','14',str(exe),'1048576',str(pat),'32768'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert q.returncode==0 and not q.stderr
    t,ch=q.stdout.split();raw[v][pat].append(float(t));checks.append(ch)
   assert len(set(checks))==1
med={v:{pat:statistics.median(x)for pat,x in xs.items()}for v,xs in raw.items()};ratio={v:{pat:med[v][pat]/med['baseline'][pat]for pat in med[v]}for v in raw};(p/'query-recheck-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(raw_ns=raw,median_ns=med,ratio=ratio),indent=2));print(ratio)

import hashlib

a='    [[nodiscard]] bool equal(';b='    [[nodiscard]] std::size_t lcp('
i=s.index(a);j=s.index(b,i);u=q.index(a);v=q.index(b,u);s=s[:i]+q[u:v]+s[j:]
a='    [[nodiscard]] int compare(';b='\nprivate:';i=s.index(a);j=s.index(b,i);u=q.index(a);v=q.index(b,u);s=s[:i]+q[u:v]+s[j:]
s=s.replace('        const std::size_t length_next = common + 1;', '        // 一致したprefixの次1byteの差だけを1回の乗算で求める。\n        const std::size_t length_next = common + 1;')
s=s.replace('        const auto factors = _mm256_set_epi64x(b4, b3, b2, base);', '        // laneは各4文字ブロック内の1〜4文字目に対応する。\n        const auto factors = _mm256_set_epi64x(b4, b3, b2, base);')
s=s.replace('            const auto hfold =', '            // 文字項を含む和は7p未満。次状態は[0,p+6]で閉じる。\n            const auto hfold =',1)
s=s.replace('        if (delta == 0) return data_[r].value == other.data_[orr].value;', '        if (delta == 0) return data_[r].value == other.data_[orr].value;\n        // 開始prefix差の1積だけで2区間のハッシュ差を比較する。',1)

from pathlib import Path

configs=[(cc,cmd,skip,fb,False)for cc,cmd in [('gcc',['/usr/bin/g++']),('clang',['/usr/bin/clang++','--gcc-install-dir=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/15'])]for skip in [False,True]for fb in [False,True]]+[('clang',['/usr/bin/clang++','--gcc-install-dir=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/15'],False,False,True),('gcc',['/usr/bin/g++'],False,True,True)]
for cc,compiler,skip,fb,san in configs:
 name=args.label+'-'+cc+('-skip'if skip else'-checked')+('-fallback'if fb else'-int128')+('-san'if san else'');exe=p/name
 flags=['-std=c++23',*(['-O1','-g','-fsanitize=address,undefined','-fno-omit-frame-pointer','-no-pie']if san else['-O2']),'-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror','-pedantic-errors','-DSIRKIT_RH_SOURCE="'+str(s)+'"',*(['-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS']if skip else[]),*(['-U__SIZEOF_INT128__','-DSIRKIT_FORCE_STANDARD_ARITHMETIC','-DSIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD']if fb else[])]
 cmd=['taskset','-c','8',*compiler,*flags,str(p/'final_block_boundary_test.cpp'),'-o',str(exe)];o=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180);r={'configuration':name,'command':cmd,'compile_exit':o.returncode,'diagnostics':o.stderr};d['runs'].append(r);dest.write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+'\n');assert o.returncode==0,o.stderr
 o=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','10',str(exe)],capture_output=True,text=True,env=dict(os.environ,ASAN_OPTIONS='detect_leaks=0')if san else None,timeout=240);r.update(run_exit=o.returncode,stdout=o.stdout,stderr=o.stderr);dest.write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+'\n');assert o.returncode==0 and not o.stderr,(name,o.stdout,o.stderr);print(name,'PASS',o.stdout.strip(),flush=True)
assert sha(s)==d['source_sha256'];d.update(passed=True,source_unchanged=True);dest.write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+'\n');print('ALL PASS',flush=True)

reproduction: 各ファイルを相対配置へ取り出し、作業パスとCPU番号を環境へ合わせる。固定main用の公式29入力と独立な線形Z法の正解は前回の保存fixtureを使い、性能記録のhashで照合する。test runnerは取得済みヘッダーと検証ソースを指定して実行する。
selection_hardware_scope: P-Coreだけを採否の根拠とする。
external_sources: 新たな外部C++実装の取得・移植はない。Boost multiprecisionはローカル独立参照テストだけの依存で、ライブラリ本体・提出コードに含めない。
